messages:
Aisha (SE): Hey team — quick sync on Panacea enterprise POC cutover windows. Sales needs final go/no-go by Wed EOD. Are we good on the staging integration deliverables?

Liam (AE): We pushed network reqs to ticket CORE-432, waiting infra signoff. CS confirmed test data access.

Jules (Eng Lead): Working through the model-mapping PR; reviewers: @Tom @Rita. PR link: github.com/redwood/panacea/pull/214 — ETA tomorrow noon.

Tom (QA): I'll review after lunch, nothing major in unit tests. Found one failing e2e in embed flow — re-running.

Rita (SRE): Cluster quotas look fine but we need node-pool resize before load test. Who owns the terraform change?

Aisha (SE): @Rita I can take the tf change but need CI green. What size to target for the resize?

Jules (Eng Lead): Increase pool to 6 g4dn nodes for peak. I'll open infra PR with plan and smoke steps. Will tag rollout bot.

k8s-bot: Deployment plan created: panacea-staging/resize -> desired_count=6; estimated time=2h after approval.

Liam (AE): CS asks for a 30-min dry-run Wed 10:00am PT. Can we lock that slot?

Jules (Eng Lead): If infra PR merged by 9:00am Wed we can run load tests at 9:30 and dry-run at 10:00. Pushing to merge queue now.

Tom (QA): Also need to bump model shard version to v2.1 in config before dry-run — quick change in config.yaml. I'll add test assertion.

Aisha (SE): I'll coordinate with CS and calendar the dry-run. Quick checklist for merge: 1) PR approvals (Jules/Tom/Rita) 2) infra resize merged 3) smoke test green. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

Jules (Eng Lead): FYI here's the resize snippet I pushed to the infra PR:
```hcl
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "panacea_staging" {
  desired_capacity = 6
  min_size = 3
  max_size = 8
}
```

Rita (SRE): Thanks — I'll review infra PR now. If everything looks good I'll approve and trigger the rollout.

Liam (AE): Great, thanks all. I'll update the customer and set expectation that we confirm Wed 9am PT.

Aisha (SE): Cool — marking this thread for follow-up. If anyone runs into merge conflicts call it out here and we'll reassign.
